issues.issue: The General Fund combining schedule (p20) labels its 1,123,264 share 'Property', and the detail records those lines as property tax. So the same money is taxes (unlabeled) on the statement and property tax in detail. Keeping it unsplit is defensible, but it needs review.
The grantor is not stated (the Statement of Activities shows operating grants and contributions), so these could be private contributions. The same judgment applies to detail[16-18] and detail[98].
This is an electric utility charge, so under the 2026-10-28 rule it is probably Utility Charges.
The proprietary expenses are listed by cost type. Bad debts is a cost-type line, not a function, so under the utility cost-type rule it would be other (function utilities).
